quote: Everyone leaves. That's what people do. They leave. And we are left to carry on.
I don't have friends. I have family, and I have people I do business with.
The problems of your past are gone. But the problems of your future are just beginning.
You can't cheat honor. Either you have it, or you don't.
Every story has a beginning and an end. Yours doesn't have to end here.
I've made a lot of mistakes in my life, but I've learned from every single one of them.
Trust is like blood. You need it to survive, but too much of it, spilled in the wrong places, and you're dead.
The truth is rarely a matter of black and white. It's usually just gray.
Secrets are a currency, Lizzy. Spend them wisely.
There's a difference between what is legal and what is right.
Fear is a tool. Used properly, it can save your life. Used improperly, it will end it.
A wise man once told me that the only way to survive is to never let them see you bleed.
Loyalty isn't a word, it's a way of life.
I've buried a lot of people I've loved. It doesn't get easier. It gets different.
Power isn't given. It's taken, one decision at a time.
Every man has a code. Mine just happens to be unwritten.
The past isn't a place you visit, Lizzy. It's a place you carry with you.
I have lived a life of shadows so that others wouldn't have to.
Regret is the price we pay for the choices that made us who we are.
I'm not a good man, Lizzy. But I have tried, in my own way, to do good things.
Killing you would be a disservice to the memory of everyone else I've killed.
Hate is a strong word. I prefer 'profound distaste'.
Every kingdom needs a boogeyman. I happen to be a very good one.
You can't make decisions based on fear of consequences, Lizzy. That's no way to live.
There's no such thing as a wrong decision. There's a decision, and then there are consequences.
You're safe. Not the same as free, but safe.
Whatever you're running from always catches up with you eventually.
The most important thing is to survive. Everything else is negotiable.
I don't make the same mistake twice. I make it five or six times, just to be sure.
Elizabeth Keen is like an animal in a cage that hasn't yet figured out the door is open.
The truth doesn't cost you anything. It's the lies that get expensive.
I've learned that the people you can't live without are the ones most likely to leave you.
A secret is only safe with one person, and even then, only for a while.
Everything I've done, I've done to buy her time. Time is the only thing worth stealing.
I'm a creature of habit and habits, like people, are hard to kill.
I don't have hobbies. I had a wife once. That was quite absorbing.
Sentiment is a luxury I gave up a long time ago.
I've buried enough people to know grief doesn't end. It just changes shape.
Do you know what a shark is, Lizzy? A perfect eating machine that never stops moving. I like sharks.
A man who doesn't spend time with his family can never be a real man.
The truth is a bell you can't unring.
I never look back, darling. It distracts from the now.
Guilt is a wasted emotion. It never once changed the past.
There are two types of people in this world: those who fear the dark, and those who own it.
Money can't buy happiness, but it can buy a very good facsimile of it.
Love makes us do the wildest things. Also the stupidest.
You don't get to choose what haunts you.
Revenge is the ghost that never leaves. It just waits for you to notice it's still there.
I've made peace with the things I can't change, and war with the things I can.
Everyone has a price. The trick is figuring out what currency they deal in.
Don't mistake my kindness for weakness. I'm just choosing not to be cruel today.
The dead don't need justice. The living do.
A good lie is built on a foundation of truth.
I don't fear death. I fear becoming irrelevant before it.
Chaos is just order waiting to be understood.
episodeTitle: And the Thrill of the Chase

quote: Some doors, once opened, can never be closed again.
You want to survive this business? Never fall in love with your own story.
Vengeance is a debt that always collects interest.
I've never met a problem money couldn't complicate further.
The wise man plans for betrayal before he needs to forgive it.
A promise is only as good as the person willing to break it for you.
Some men are haunted by ghosts. I'm haunted by choices.
I have outlived most of my enemies and all of my illusions.
Redemption isn't a destination, Lizzy. It's a direction.
Every empire I've built was made of favors owed, not friendships kept.
The last thing a dying man loses is his sense of humor. I intend to keep mine.
Legacy isn't what you leave behind. It's what refuses to leave you.
I've spent my whole life building a fortress around one person. Maybe that was the point all along.
When the story ends, Lizzy, it isn't the crimes they'll remember. It's who you protected.
In the end, we are all just stories someone else decides how to tell.
I made a promise to a dying woman. Everything since has just been keeping it.
Retirement is just another word for waiting to be found.
An empire built on secrets eventually becomes a prison made of them.
Every man I've betrayed is a debt. I intend to die owing as few as possible.
A congressman with a subpoena is still just a man with a piece of paper.
I've spent my life staying one step ahead of the people who want me dead. Old habits don't retire either.
Family isn't the people who share your blood. It's the people who show up when the bull is charging.
I never asked to be remembered fondly. Just remembered accurately.
The last chapter doesn't erase the ones before it. It just explains them.
A criminal empire is just a family business with worse hours.
I don't collect enemies. They just accumulate, like dust.
The people who scare me most are the ones who never raise their voice.
There's no version of this life where everyone I love stays safe. I chose anyway.
Ambition without patience is just noise.
I've been called many things. Only one of them ever really mattered: hers.
A man who never lies has simply never needed to.
Time doesn't heal wounds. It just teaches you to carry them differently.
I never trust a man who doesn't enjoy a good meal. It means he doesn't trust himself.
Nostalgia is a drug. I've learned to take it in very small doses.
The FBI thinks in evidence. I think in people. People are far less predictable.
You don't need to raise your voice when everyone in the room already fears you.
Forgiveness is a gift you give yourself. It rarely has anything to do with the other person.
A good enemy is worth more than a mediocre friend. At least you know where you stand.
I don't believe in closure. I believe in managing what's left open.
Every empire falls eventually. The trick is choosing when to let go of the reins.
I've never been afraid of dying. I've only ever been afraid of being forgotten.
Kindness is not weakness. It is the discipline of strength held in check.
A confession is just a story with the ending already decided.
There's a difference between running from your past and finally outrunning it.
In the end, all any of us leave behind is who we chose to protect.
